title: Reformationstidens danske salme- og messeboeger digitaliseret (salmer.dsl.dk)
notes: DSL project 'Musik og sprog i reformationstidens danske salmesang' (Carlsberg-funded) digitally published nine Danish hymnals and mass books of the Reformation era, 1529–1573; the four harvested texts (christian-3-bibel 1550, claus-mortensen-messe-1529, dietz-salmebog-1529/1536, jespersen_1573) match the origin ids 'DSL DSL_Salmer: ...' exactly by slug. Texts are served as TEI/XML from DSL's eXist-db (RQ harvest path data/raw/dsl_salmer/eXist-dbs/salmer/xml/), with companion portals melodier.dsl.dk and ordnet.dk/ren; project page at dsl.dk/projekter/musik-og-sprog-i-reformationstidens-danske-salmesang (200). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Det Danske Sprog- og Litteraturselskab (DSL), Copenhagen
